symptom: describe -> exec of Studio Pro pages/snippets: nested snippet calls lost their Forms$SnippetParameterMapping (TestApp 32; exec then refused the call as missing a required parameter), input widgets inside a data view lost SourceVariable {Widget: dataView1, PageParameter: Account} (PedApp Account_Edit/Account_New), `{1} = $dataView1.Name` was written as PageParameter=dataView1 (mx check CE1152 "Missing page parameter 'dataView1'"), and every snippet call gained a null ConditionalVisibilitySettings key.
cause: describe had no reader for SnippetCall.ParameterMappings and none for an input's SourceVariable; the builder had no Widget slot, so a data-container name in paramEntityNames fell into the page-parameter path; Forms$SnippetCallWidget was registered with a NullFields entry for a property its type does not have.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go (extractSnippetCallParams, extractInputAttribute), cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go (sourceVariableBinding reads Widget first), cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (registerDataViewVariable, widgetVariableFor, resolveInputBinding), mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (pageVariableToGen, inputSourceVariableToGen, SnippetCallWidget defaults), mdl/backend/widgetobj/builder.go, grammar widgetAttributeRefV3
insight: Measure the slot Studio Pro stores by feeding its MCP server the minimal form and reading back: given only {widget: dataView1}, Studio Pro 11.14 stored {widget: dataView1, pageParameter: Car} itself, which settled the two-slot shape without a UI session. A fix that lets a document EXECUTE moves it from lawExec to lawGetPut in the allowlist: the exec failure had been masking unrelated drift (here a null key on every snippet call, and the association-path template parameter class), so expect the allowlist to change laws, not only shrink. A NullFields registration for a property the generated type lacks writes a key Studio Pro never stores: check `grep 'func (o *T) SetX'` in modelsdk/gen before registering a default. Page Variables are primitive-only and snippet parameters entity-only (CE0046), so a page variable passed to a snippet call has no valid Studio Pro shape: the LocalVariable slot only names it correctly; mx check still says CE0115.
